newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SNB keeps discount at 1.00 pct after meeting.
newsitem.headline: SNB keeps discount at 1.00 pct after meeting.

text.p: The Swiss National Bank (SNB) said it was leaving its discount rate unchanged after its weekly meeting of its three-member policy-setting board.
"No change," a spokesman for the SNB said.
The rate, now at 1.00 percent, was last changed when it was lowered from 1.50 percent on September 26, 1996.
The rate at its current level matches the historic low maintained from February 1978 to November 1979.
